scope: Broaden MLEADER research across the authoritative DWG specification, Autodesk DXF references, open-source parser/writer models, and the local adapter; refine implementation readiness without promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary standards and current upstream-source/documentation review plus local source audit
method.evidenceRule: Standards establish layout and code meanings; peer documentation/source supplies differential leads only. Source inspection and same-implementation roundtrip do not establish independent semantic or native-consumer support.

evidence.observed: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.48 says MLEADER was introduced in DWG version 21 and embeds substantial content/leader state in MLeaderAnnotContext; §§20.4.86 and 20.4.87 describe the context and style structures.
evidence.planUse: Use AC1021 as the conservative supported writer floor pending producer-generated lower-version evidence; keep context and style as separate compound schemas.

evidence.observed: Entity, nested context, leader-line, and MLEADERSTYLE records reuse group codes such as 340/341 with different target kinds.
evidence.planUse: Inventory and validate references using record scope, nested parser state, group code, and target kind; require source and emitted target uniqueness.

evidence.topic: ezdxf DXF model and version discrepancy
evidence.observed: The docs describe context roots/lines/breaks, MTEXT/BLOCK content, and MULTILEADER spelling; they warn that override flags may not match effective values and state a DXF R2000 minimum, which does not align with the ODA DWG introduction version.
doesNotEstablish: native producer compatibility for pre-AC1021 DXF
which entity/override value is authoritative in every application
local semantic correctness or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Preserve override flags and values independently, test exact-version producers/consumers, and keep pre-AC1021 output experimental until the discrepancy is resolved.

evidence.topic: Open-source peer maturity and test boundaries
evidence.observed: LibreDWG marks MULTILEADER stable and its MLEADER context class debugging. ACadSharp exposes structured entity/per-line override state but its current branch documents uncertain areas. ACadRust has a generated MultiLeader roundtrip and clears multiple handles during normalization.
doesNotEstablish: the completeness of either peer's current release
an independent reader/writer result from same-implementation roundtrip
evidence.planUse: Use peers as pinned differential leads and field inventories; record entity body, nested context, and reference closure separately.

evidence.topic: Local adapter delivery and writer audit
sources: dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h: no addMLeader override; neighboring entity callbacks retain copies
src/drw_interface.h: addMLeader has a default no-op
src/libdxfrw.cpp: processMultiLeader calls addMLeader after context closure
src/libdxfrw.cpp: writeMultiLeader checks only the AC1009 floor and emits nested references directly
dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp: fail-closed MLEADER guard checks only entities retained in dx_data; writeEntity has no MLEADER case
src/drw_entities.cpp: unknown nested-context codes return success and are consumed
evidence.observed: Parser-delivered leaders reach the inherited no-op callback and are not retained by dx_iface, so the later retained-entity refusal guard cannot see them. The low-level serializer is not wired to the adapter, accepts versions below AC1021, and does not remap all entity/context/line/legacy-array handles. Unknown nested-context tags may be silently lost.
evidence.planUse: Immediate safe slice is callback retention plus strict fail-closed export and destination-preservation tests. Follow with nested unknown-field policy, writer version floor, complete typed reference closure, and independent qualification.

implementationReadiness.immediateSlice: Retain parser-delivered MLEADER entities in dx_iface and prove adapter export refuses without modifying the destination until a qualified serializer is connected.
subsequentGates: Preserve unknown nested context tags or fail closed; validate nested grammar and resource budgets.
Enforce AC1021 minimum support until lower-version DXF interoperability is resolved.
Resolve style, linetype, arrow BLOCK_RECORD, text STYLE, content BLOCK_RECORD, ATTDEF, owner, and layout edges by nested scope and emitted handle mapping.
Cover MTEXT, BLOCK, none, and explicitly supported/refused TOLERANCE payload states; roots, lines, breaks, transforms, attributes, overrides, and versioned arrays.
Require pinned independent reader and exact-version native CAD outcomes before any support promotion.
